description: Turn local PDF and BibTeX papers into per-paper markdown note card skeletons under the project's notes/ directory, completing missing metadata from OpenAlex. Existing notes are never overwritten.

path.description: Absolute path to the research project folder (the folder that contains papers/ and notes/).

files.description: Optional list of absolute PDF or .bib file paths. When omitted, every PDF and .bib file under papers/ (including papers/_inbox/) is scanned.
